Before converting, the launcher compares the SHA256 of the original DLLs. It converts and launches only when every file matches a supported version. If Steam has a newer version than these, wait for a launcher update.

This deletes the game files, install output and Steam download cache on this phone. Saves, the Steam login and Cloud status are kept, and you can import or download from Steam again later.
An install or the game is running. Stop it before removing.
An unofficial Android launcher for Monster Train 2

Download the game you bought with your own Steam account and convert it into a playable version on your phone. This app contains no game files and offers no way around Steam licensing. Not affiliated with Shiny Shoe or Big Fan Games.

Reads the game assets on the phone
Your password and Steam Guard codes stay in memory only and are never written to files or logs. After login, only the refresh token is kept, encrypted with Android Keystore; logging out deletes it.
